### Why Gin Hangovers Happen

- **Ethanol and dehydration:** Alcohol increases urination, disrupts sleep, and irritates the stomach lining regardless of the spirit.
- **Fewer congeners:** Clear spirits like gin contain fewer fermentation byproducts (congeners) than dark liquors, which can reduce hangover intensity.
- **Mixers and sugar:** Sugary mixers or high-sugar tonic water can spike blood sugar and worsen dehydration, while club soda adds hydration.
- **Botanicals and individual response:** Botanicals or additives in certain gins can affect people differently . On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13k3bFFcJJocT9WG3sNK5qfQGYG9yPhDEUEdtoB_KrBVNN2TqcZZzr5aCZbpXXxlzsdUd4LZp9VqN85OpUolz-5uvFwdWuP7jCyZTW-PYTMRkx3RFrSKTk4agON9-3XVF6OZ5vg_ll1y0QB32VOemLouWZuD5RAcOhvIwHPMhKeLtTyX76vRtUXFqOY) , opinions on gin hangovers are mixed—some users report fewer hangovers with gin when they pace themselves and hydrate, while others note that total alcohol intake and added sugar matter most. On [Quora](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF14vgjLEi4dwY8qeCHTfzHgjgtCaSOit8ov7zDbz83-wSGFHRUVtxdtcar86zjntQdPYNn981D6l9ILp368WOwcNCPc8DSA3M3f-v9vZwoflyJxQMXYQ-I1fVz-B_Z-iBELqCL3-bYoJi8WzrS7ZZ7-2TC8W7z7wYu-tQu3Gqlv7rmbI) , there is a consensus that gin's botanicals or congeners—unlike plain vodka—can contribute to hangovers for some people.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13k3bFFcJJocT9WG3sNK5qfQGYG9yPhDEUEdtoB_KrBVNN2TqcZZzr5aCZbpXXxlzsdUd4LZp9VqN85OpUolz-5uvFwdWuP7jCyZTW-PYTMRkx3RFrSKTk4agON9-3XVF6OZ5vg_ll1y0QB32VOemLouWZuD5RAcOhvIwHPMhKeLtTyX76vRtUXFqOY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXsBV2Vag4OiK8HZRzZbGcp6X87g2SnZtLXMq4e9JoT3juCTqF1JPKkNQGIOjTIdOtyFQEdnDa2OgUcqMXG21bpU5PzfA1-EBFSHZ0Brm7FkR_O7wf0ILMUNgaDDi660EdIFyz5bwkGtexEkaigIyS)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1yeuCU-GFSpp-Qb6EnBp8UgrmdT-M6sjv8ImyfRHWM0NlHUvee8-dEDJCFlXVMVRt-_3sq1t29oDz1XX7zEd6XYXo9f_XK70bhZPhBy5edlLiGvgKFEaTldhfcjZ_woQywUIXkmtfPJv2YX-d-knMSn0jAUG9i1bwHzRbxJuYUH_-BFcRKXPmEEC694)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF1_EzXgnHGLbvIJqMEEuMtm7ELvhT91qNes3-JQDcxgeW04dg2ZoMB5qbT17aKHob04BY71z5XdT8ypI0vtoD1dLj2eJi63GmeiB2CixcSP7MdDvT0hv7VGhlltiuq7Jf0foLd2vhWuMRcIrNCycchKumyBu7WjaSjvrTw2EYmIOcvt1YFOjiJyrY5XI6pTe-MuYhkA0VP_DzbbTeJN2elrv-dgT_uJb3)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXRDCA1hRu-rOjh3BRT9U4A0q0yGEkUd7s-fkrdw-gz928QbM7LQn9eRScQw0HoVnwtmu313gEMh8UgZx1f5Ut8uBglCCDnWKtSjnLCzjR_6HhKmOXMFyZuowGmu4qI1EQ)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF14vgjLEi4dwY8qeCHTfzHgjgtCaSOit8ov7zDbz83-wSGFHRUVtxdtcar86zjntQdPYNn981D6l9ILp368WOwcNCPc8DSA3M3f-v9vZwoflyJxQMXYQ-I1fVz-B_Z-iBELqCL3-bYoJi8WzrS7ZZ7-2TC8W7z7wYu-tQu3Gqlv7rmbI)

### Ways to Reduce Risk

- **Pace and hydrate:** Alternate gin drinks with water and eat before or while drinking. As noted by [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1yeuCU-GFSpp-Qb6EnBp8UgrmdT-M6sjv8ImyfRHWM0NlHUvee8-dEDJCFlXVMVRt-_3sq1t29oDz1XX7zEd6XYXo9f_XK70bhZPhBy5edlLiGvgKFEaTldhfcjZ_woQywUIXkmtfPJv2YX-d-knMSn0jAUG9i1bwHzRbxJuYUH_-BFcRKXPmEEC694) , drinking water between alcoholic beverages and sticking to moderate limits helps prevent hangovers.
- **Watch the mixer:** Choose low-sugar mixers like club soda with citrus instead of heavy syrups or sugary sodas.
- **Prioritize rest:** Give your body time and fluids to recover, since only time and avoiding excess alcohol truly prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF13pDaAOcaRmpTCA0JSRjalz_ooWJimR-wls2OqRXb9TU3vsbBMEenIm5cv3OMUNF34lCcPR5s3Ai1_TXVeEmsFCW9f35IJKYqriJe6HmKuV7DpwjzdsUCFaDNt9OGb5TY9VkyQmEVDUST4rB5cyyQzAxjM6WlKYtw75j3Gsk1MTVObntnHTsDwWNP9Zs1-kP8yk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1yeuCU-GFSpp-Qb6EnBp8UgrmdT-M6sjv8ImyfRHWM0NlHUvee8-dEDJCFlXVMVRt-_3sq1t29oDz1XX7zEd6XYXo9f_XK70bhZPhBy5edlLiGvgKFEaTldhfcjZ_woQywUIXkmtfPJv2YX-d-knMSn0jAUG9i1bwHzRbxJuYUH_-BFcRKXPmEEC694)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXRDCA1hRu-rOjh3BRT9U4A0q0yGEkUd7s-fkrdw-gz928QbM7LQn9eRScQw0HoVnwtmu313gEMh8UgZx1f5Ut8uBglCCDnWKtSjnLCzjR_6HhKmOXMFyZuowGmu4qI1EQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF17lPt7Em7DX8KAA6bmYh-B0l4pdDxFnMhEoBdaMsC9BY0xiYFgzBAS5Kq9Uigkos8ApCi7o4dSYezzNr4_4BVT0XRJ80M4Ds40fV72YbpSKRn2HDw17LlBAgx2UCPea5-4IR4cz1-pamDPJMQKKXShhMJnBBceBBcA3xzL6BMgg8Qm23LIeloza2XdmwcqhC-1k)
